outcome_evidence: In base_image, frames 400–1000 show the robot separating and arranging the green cups, followed by acquisition and repositioning at frames 1100–1400. At frame 1500 the left gripper lowers its cup over the others; frame 1600 shows the gripper withdrawing and leaving a compact nested stack. The stack remains stable with both grippers clear through frames 1700–1760. “Pack” is interpreted as compactly nesting the cups, since no separate packaging destination is specified or visible. No failed acquisition, harmful side effect, or sustained unproductive interval is established.
